layers.name: Olle Route 1: Siheung-ri → Gwangchigi Beach, 14.9 km (1코스)

line.name: Olle Route 1: Siheung-ri bus stop → Malmi Oreum → Jongdal-ri → Seongsan → Gwangchigi Beach (시흥리 → 광치기해변), 14.9 km

segments.label: Official Jeju Olle 1 course line from Naver Map (제주올레길 1코스)

pins.name: Start – Siheung-ri bus stop (시흥리 버스정류장)
pins.desc: Official start of Route 1 and of the whole Olle trail, 0 km. The start stamp box stands here; the Olle information desk is 1 km on at the foot of Malmi Oreum. Bus 201 from Jeju City or Seogwipo.

pins.name: Jeju Olle Route 1 information desk (제주올레 1코스 공식안내소)
pins.desc: Official Olle desk at the foot of Malmi Oreum: passports, maps, toilets and a first-aid kit.

pins.name: Malmi Oreum, Dusan-bong (말미오름) (두산봉)
pins.desc: The first climb of the trail: a low crater rim with the classic view of Seongsan Ilchulbong and Udo floating behind it. Al Oreum is the second, smaller cone just beyond.

pins.name: Jongdal-ri old salt fields (종달리소금밭체험시설)
pins.desc: Reclaimed salt pans of Jongdal, once the island's main salt source; the 2.4 km wheelchair-accessible stretch to the Seongsan floodgate starts here.

pins.name: Jongdal-ri village office (무더위쉼터 종달리사무소)
pins.desc: Village office with a summer rest room; the route turns to the coast here.

pins.name: Jongdal Badang-gil coast path (종달바당)
pins.desc: Start of the Jongdal shore path along the lagoon towards Seongsan.

pins.name: Mokhwa rest stop – mid-route stamp (목화휴게소)
pins.desc: Roadside rest stop on the Haemaji coast road with the middle stamp box and a simple restaurant.

pins.name: Siheung-ri haenyeo house (시흥리 해녀의집)
pins.desc: The diving women's cooperative restaurant: abalone and sea-urchin porridge from their own catch. Toilets for walkers next door.

pins.name: Ojo-ri haenyeo house (오조해녀의집)
pins.desc: Second haenyeo restaurant on the lagoon shore, just before the Seongsan floodgate where the accessible section ends.

pins.name: Teojinmok – April 3rd memorial site (터진목)
pins.desc: Memorial at the neck of the Seongsan peninsula to the victims of the 1948 Jeju uprising. First-aid kit here.

pins.name: Seongsan Ilchulbong (성산일출봉) (성산일출봉)
pins.desc: The sunrise peak, a UNESCO tuff cone 180 m high; the route passes below it. Ticketed climb, 50 minutes return, if you have the time.

pins.name: Gwangchigi Beach (광치기해변)
pins.desc: Black-sand beach with the green algae-covered rocks at low tide and Ilchulbong straight across the water. Sunrise spot.

pins.name: End – Gwangchigi Beach stamp box (광치기해변 스탬프찍는곳)
pins.desc: Official finish of Route 1, 14.9 km. Route 2 starts here; buses to Seongsan and Jeju City from the main road.

layers.name: Olle Route 1-1: Udo loop from Cheonjin Port, 11.3 km (1-1코스 우도)

line.name: Olle Route 1-1: Cheonjin Port → coral beach → Hau-mokdong → Hagosudong → Udobong → Cheonjin Port (천진항 한 바퀴), 11.3 km

segments.label: Official Jeju Olle 1-1 course line from Naver Map (제주올레길 1-1코스)

pins.name: Start / End A – Cheonjin Port (천진항)
pins.desc: Official start and finish of Route 1-1 at the main ferry pier from Seongsan. Start stamp box, toilets and the ticket office.

pins.name: Hundertwasser Park (훈데르트바서파크)
pins.desc: Village of buildings in the style of the Austrian artist, with a café and gallery, just outside Cheonjin.

pins.name: Hongjo-dangoe Haebin, the coral-sand beach (제주 우도 홍조단괴 해빈)
pins.desc: Natural monument: the white beach is made of calcified red algae, not coral. The clearest water on the island.

pins.name: Seobin Baeksa beach (산호해수욕장)
pins.desc: The swimming beach on the coral sand, with cafés and the view back to Seongsan.

pins.name: Start / End B – Hau-mokdong Port (하우목동항대합실)
pins.desc: Alternative start and finish, the second ferry pier; stamp box, toilets and the waiting room.

pins.name: Bangsatap stone tower (방사탑)
pins.desc: Traditional stone tower built to ward off bad luck, on the north shore before Hagosudong.

pins.name: Hagosudong Beach – mid-route stamp (하고수동해수욕장)
pins.desc: Shallow white-sand bay on the north-east coast; the middle stamp box stands in front of the noodle house on the beach road.

pins.name: Ttitti-ppangppang viewpoint (띠띠빵빵)
pins.desc: East-coast viewpoint and restaurant with the lava cliffs below.

pins.name: Geommeolle black-sand beach (optional detour) (검멀레해수욕장)
pins.desc: Tiny black-sand cove under the Udobong cliffs with the whale cave; 300 m off the route.

pins.name: Udo Lighthouse and park (우도등대)
pins.desc: Lighthouse park on the summit plateau of Udobong, with the lighthouse museum and the whole island below.

pins.name: Udobong, 132 m (우도봉)
pins.desc: The island's one hill, the cow's head of its name; grass slopes and the cliff edge over Geommeolle.

pins.name: End A stamp – Cheonjin Port stamp box (천진항 스탬프찍는곳)
pins.desc: End stamp box of Route 1-1 at the pier.

pins.name: Route 1 start stamp – Siheung-ri bus stop (시작 스탬프)
pins.desc: Start stamp box of Route 1.

pins.name: Route 1 mid-route stamp – Mokhwa rest stop (중간 스탬프 · 목화휴게소)
pins.desc: Middle stamp box of Route 1.

pins.name: Route 1 end stamp – Gwangchigi Beach (종점 스탬프 · 광치기해변)
pins.desc: End stamp box of Route 1.

pins.name: Route 1-1 start / end stamp – Cheonjin Port (천진항 스탬프찍는곳)
pins.desc: Start and end stamp box of the Udo loop.

pins.name: Route 1-1 mid-route stamp – Hagosudong Beach (중간 스탬프 · 하고수동해수욕장 범선국수 앞)
pins.desc: Middle stamp box, in front of the noodle house on the beach road.

pins.name: Route 1-1 start / end B stamp – Hau-mokdong Port (하우목동항 스탬프찍는곳)
pins.desc: Alternative start and end stamp box.

pins.desc: Public toilet. 제주 서귀포시 성산읍 시흥리 1074-6.

pins.desc: Public toilet. 제주 제주시 우도면 우도해안길 256.

pins.desc: Public toilet. 제주 제주시 우도면 연평리.

pins.name: Toilet – North shore (공용화장실)
pins.desc: Public toilet. 제주 제주시 우도면 연평리 2656.

pins.name: Toilet – Hagosudong changing rooms (하고수동탈의장공중화장실)
pins.desc: Public toilet. 제주 제주시 우도면 우도해안길 804.

pins.name: Toilet – Hagosudong east (개방화장실)
pins.desc: Public toilet. 제주 제주시 우도면 연평리 682-6.

pins.name: Toilet – Udobong (우도봉화장실)
pins.desc: Public toilet. 제주 제주시 우도면 영일길 80-34.

pins.name: Toilet – Udo Lighthouse (공용화장실)
pins.desc: Public toilet. 제주 제주시 우도면 우도봉길 105.

pins.name: Toilet – Udobong foot (우도봉공중화장실)
pins.desc: Public toilet. 제주 제주시 우도면 우도봉길 47.

pins.name: First-aid kit – Route 1 information desk (구급함 · 제주올레 공식안내소)
pins.desc: First-aid kit per the official Olle map.

pins.name: First-aid kit – Teojinmok (구급함 · 터진목)
pins.desc: First-aid kit per the official Olle map.

pins.name: Jongdal Sudatteul – Korean set meals (종달수다뜰)
pins.desc: Village restaurant in Jongdal-ri at 5.7 km, set meals on a terrace. Still in business on Naver as of 2026-10-21.

pins.name: Sunhui Bapsang – home cooking (순희밥상)
pins.desc: Home-style table in Jongdal village at 6.5 km. Still in business on Naver as of 2026-10-21.

pins.name: Badaneun Anboyeoyo café (바다는안보여요)
pins.desc: 'You can't see the sea' café in a Jongdal farmhouse at 6.4 km, the village's best-known coffee stop. Still in business on Naver as of 2026-10-21.

pins.name: Jongdal-ri 746 book café (종달리746)
pins.desc: Book café in a renovated house in Jongdal-ri. Still in business on Naver as of 2026-10-21.

pins.name: Mokhwa rest stop restaurant (목화휴게소)
pins.desc: Simple Korean food at the mid-route stamp. Still in business on Naver as of 2026-10-21.

pins.name: Siheung-ri haenyeo house – abalone porridge (시흥리 해녀의집)
pins.desc: The divers' own restaurant on the coast road at 8.9 km. Still in business on Naver as of 2026-10-21.

pins.name: Ojo-ri haenyeo house – seafood (오조해녀의집)
pins.desc: Second haenyeo restaurant on the lagoon at 10.3 km. Still in business on Naver as of 2026-10-21.

pins.name: Seongsan Bom Juk Kalguksu – porridge and noodles (성산봄죽칼국수 성산점)
pins.desc: Porridge and knife-cut noodles in Ojo-ri at 10.1 km. Still in business on Naver as of 2026-10-21.

pins.name: Seongsan fisheries co-op raw fish centre (성산포수협 활어회센터)
pins.desc: Raw fish straight from the co-op at Seongsan Port, 11.6 km. Still in business on Naver as of 2026-10-21.

pins.name: Seongsan Bada Punggyeong – seafood with the peak view (성산바다풍경 제주성산일출봉점)
pins.desc: Seafood restaurant under Ilchulbong at 13 km. Still in business on Naver as of 2026-10-21.

pins.name: Haeilli café – Seongsan bay view (해일리 카페)
pins.desc: Coast café on the bay below Ilchulbong at 12.4 km. Still in business on Naver as of 2026-10-21.

pins.name: Café The Light – Ilchulbong view (카페더라이트)
pins.desc: Café on the shore road facing the sunrise peak, 12.9 km. Still in business on Naver as of 2026-10-21.

pins.name: Fritz Coffee Seongsan (프릳츠 제주성산점)
pins.desc: The Seoul roaster's Seongsan branch, 1 km before the finish. Still in business on Naver as of 2026-10-21.

pins.name: Jeju Sanbang Sikdang Udo – Korean (제주산방식당 우도점)
pins.desc: Korean meals by Cheonjin Port at the start of the loop. Still in business on Naver as of 2026-10-21.

pins.name: Café Yellow – peanut ice cream (카페옐로우)
pins.desc: Udo peanut ice cream at the pier, the island's signature. Still in business on Naver as of 2026-10-21.

pins.name: Sanhosa haenyeo restaurant – seafood (산호사해녀식당)
pins.desc: Divers' seafood at the coral beach, 2.6 km. Still in business on Naver as of 2026-10-21.

pins.name: Udorang café – west coast view (우도랑)
pins.desc: Café right on the west shore path at 3.1 km, Seongsan across the water. Still in business on Naver as of 2026-10-21.

pins.name: Udo haenyeo restaurant – seafood (우도해녀식당)
pins.desc: Seafood on the north-west shore at 4.4 km. Still in business on Naver as of 2026-10-21.

pins.name: Udo seafood ramyeon – Hagosudong (우도해물라면)
pins.desc: Seafood ramyeon on Hagosudong Beach, next to the mid-route stamp. Still in business on Naver as of 2026-10-21.

pins.name: Blanc Rocher – Hagosudong beach café (블랑로쉐)
pins.desc: Big white café above Hagosudong Beach with the turquoise bay in the window. Still in business on Naver as of 2026-10-21.

pins.name: Annyeong Yukji Saram café (안녕육지사람)
pins.desc: 'Hello, mainlanders' café on the Hagosudong shore. Still in business on Naver as of 2026-10-21.

pins.name: Ttitti-ppangppang – east coast restaurant (띠띠빵빵)
pins.desc: Chinese-Korean restaurant and viewpoint on the east cliffs, 8.1 km. Still in business on Naver as of 2026-10-21.

pins.name: Udo Ice Cream Lab (우도 아이스크림연구소)
pins.desc: Ice cream at the foot of Udobong, 11.9 km. Still in business on Naver as of 2026-10-21.

pins.name: Hundertwinds café (훈데르트윈즈)
pins.desc: Café at the Hundertwasser Park near the finish. Still in business on Naver as of 2026-10-21.
